inputs.content: I'm planning a solo hike in the mountains. What safety precautions should I take?
Make sure to bring plenty of water, a map, and let someone know your route and expected return time.

I'm planning a solo hike in the mountains this weekend. I've got my emergency shelter and blanket packed.
That sounds like a great adventure! Just to confirm, you do have a first aid kit and a means of communication, right?
Yes, I've got all the essentials. I'm just double-checking the weather forecast to make sure I'm prepared for any conditions.
Good thinking. It's always better to be safe than sorry. Have a great hike!

I see. Well, if you're concerned, you could try keeping a food diary to see if you can identify any triggers. And if it doesn't improve, consider speaking with a doctor.
Okay, that sounds like a good plan. Thanks for the advice.
